name: Shard of Xoriat
binding_raw: Bound to Account on Acquire , Exclusive

effects.name: Exceptional Charisma
effects.tooltip: Exceptional Charisma +1 : This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +1 Exceptional bonus to Charisma.

effects.name: Summon Xoriat Horror
effects.tooltip: Summon Xoriat Horror Caster level: 20 Charges: 3 (3/day)

effects.name: Enchantment Focus
effects.tooltip: Enchantment Focus +2 : +2 Equipment bonus to the DC of Enchantment spells.

flavor_text: A crystalline fragment of some Xoriat mineral. The magic it is enchanted with will make the wearer a more charismatic leader, and even grants the service of several Xoriat creatures each day.
tips: The monsters summoned by this item are: Chaos Beholder , CR16 Greater Evil Eye , CR15 Mind Flayer Mage , CR16 Taken , CR13 Xorian Render , CR15 (Flesh Render) Notes: Early version of this item was not exclusive . Even if you have the old non-exclusive version in your inventory, you cannot loot a new one. Using the clicky in public area displays the summoning animation and consumes a charge from the item without any effect.
